topic: Forms of Energy and Heat Transfer
key_concepts: Energy is the ability to do work
Kinetic energy is energy of a moving object
Potential energy is energy of objects at rest
Sound energy is produced by vibrating objects
Nuclear energy comes from the nucleus of an atom
Static electricity is energy of charges at rest while electric current is the net flow of
The Law of Conservation of Energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed, only
Heat transfers from hot to cold objects by conduction, convection, and radiation
The Sun is the main source of energy on Earth and transfers heat through radiation
Geothermal energy comes from heat inside the Earth
Ultrasound and sonar are applications of sound energy
Solar panels and windmills transform sunlight and mechanical energy into electricity
